nodes.label: Agentic Coding and Persistent Returns to Expertise
nodes.author: Zoe Hitzig, Maxim Massenkoff, Eva Lyubich, Ryan Heller, Peter McCrory
nodes.rationale: Report analyzing Claude Code usage patterns across ~400,000 sessions from ~235,000 users (Oct 2025–Apr 2026), examining how domain expertise (not coding proficiency) drives success in agentic coding tasks.

nodes.label: Claude Code
nodes.rationale: AI-powered coding assistant enabling interactive sessions through CLI, claude.ai, and desktop app; users spend avg 20 hrs/week; adoption doubled since late 2025.

nodes.label: Division of Labor in Agentic Coding
nodes.rationale: Users make ~70% of planning decisions (what to build); Claude makes ~80% of execution decisions (how to build it). Clear separation of human judgment from agent implementation.

nodes.label: Expertise Classifier (Task-Specific)
nodes.rationale: Five-point scale (novice to expert) measuring task-specific domain knowledge, not job title or general ability. Signals: precision of framing, verification requests, correction patterns.

nodes.label: Success Measures in Claude Code Sessions
nodes.rationale: Judged success (transcript-based), verified success (hard signals: commits, tests, explicit affirmation), partial success. Novice: 15% verified, 77% partial. Intermediate+: 28–33% verified, 91–92% partial.

nodes.label: Nine Work Modes in Claude Code
nodes.rationale: Building (25%), fixing (26%), testing/orchestrating (5%), operating software (17%), planning/exploring (14%), analyzing/prose (13%). Composition shifted Oct 2025–Apr 2026: fixing ↓33%→19%, operating ↑14%→21%.

nodes.label: Occupational Classification (SOC Taxonomy)
nodes.rationale: Inferred from session context (project structure, file names, artifacts, vocabulary), not coding activity. 70% of sessions classified. Largest: Computer/Math (expected), then Business/Finance, Arts/Design, Management, Life/Physical/Social Sciences.

nodes.label: Task Value Estimation (Freelance Marketplace Calibration)
nodes.rationale: Estimated session value rose 27% Oct–Apr. Building/operating/fixing tasks grew 43%/34%/32% respectively. Used for relative comparison, not absolute dollar values.

hyperedges.label: Domain Expertise as Primary Driver of AI Tool Effectiveness
